questions.independentDerivation: Let x be the horizontal distance from the nearer observation point to the building and y the height above eye level. From tan 45° = y/x, x = y. From tan 30° = y/(x + 25.7), sqrt(3)y = y + 25.7, so y = 25.7/(sqrt(3) - 1). The building height is h = y + 1.7 ≈ 36.807 m, or 37 m to the nearest metre. The native calculation is correct, but its variable d is not defined.

questions.independentDerivation: The ten congruent central triangles each have angle 360°/10 = 36°. Thus 100 = 10(½r² sin 36°), giving r = sqrt(20/sin 36°) ≈ 5.833 cm. Bisecting a central triangle gives half a side r sin 18°, so the perimeter is 20r sin 18° ≈ 36.051 cm to three decimal places. Both native answers and worked solutions agree.
